provenance.notes: Synthetic: entries exercising absent values, which the live recording does not contain: an entry with no dates, issuer id or serial; an entry with null dates and issuer; an entry with a validity end and an entry_timestamp (a field older crt.sh answers carried, which the previous codebase used in place of a missing not_before) but no not_before; an issuer name without O=; a quoted O= containing a comma; an upper-case name with a trailing dot; and a name under a reserved TLD that only starts with the queried domain. crt.sh publishes no API documentation, so this follows the shape of the recorded fixtures (found-example-com.json, empty-example-invalid.json). Ids 1 to 4, the dates and every bracketed value are placeholders, not real crt.sh data.
